author: manisha
title: Secured & Monitored CI/CD Pipeline for Automated Container Deployment
content: This project implements a fully automated CI/CD pipeline designed to bridge the gap between development and production. By leveraging Jenkins, Docker, and GitHub, the system ensures that any code change pushed by a developer is automatically tested, built into a container image, and deployed to a live environment without manual intervention. website maintaining a rigorous security posture through deep operational visibility via the Prometheus-Grafana.
